name: profile
description: One PISCO profile, camera output to EcoTaxa: build profile_dataset.h5 from the frames and the sensor log, segment, deconvolve, extract, classify with the dual ViT, export to EcoTaxa, import, attach embeddings. Settings are the ones settled in the pipeline comparison (Sept 2026): 12-frame background block, 30 px of context around each object, texture atlas, crops handed on as the object alone.

ctd_cast.title: CTD cast
ctd_cast.description: Running number of the CTD cast on this cruise, as counted from DSHIP's CTD operations; Fill from DSHIP sets it

frames.title: Frames (folder)
frames.description: Raw frames of this profile: a folder of images, or of the PISCO3 recorder's .h5 files (then set the cast's start and end time)

skip_first.title: Skip first frames
skip_first.description: Frames dropped at the start of the profile; the frame directory's depth preview sets this by dragging over the part to keep

skip_last.title: Skip last frames
skip_last.description: Frames dropped at the end, e.g. the upcast

start_time.title: Cast start (UTC)
start_time.description: Keep frames from this time on, e.g. 2026-10-19T02:53:28Z. For recordings that hold more than one cast (the PISCO3 recorder's folder); Fill from DSHIP / Pick a cast sets it to 'in the water'. Leave empty for a folder holding one profile.

end_time.title: Cast end (UTC)
end_time.description: Keep frames up to this time; DSHIP fills 'on deck'. For the downcast only, use the max-depth time DSHIP reports.

image_size.title: Frame size (px)
image_size.description: Width = height of the camera's frames, for both segmenter passes: 2560 for PISCO2, 4504 for PISCO3. A mismatch stops the segmenter.

pixel_size_um.title: Pixel size (µm)
pixel_size_um.description: Micrometres per pixel, for the scale bar and object_esd in EcoTaxa: 22.5 for PISCO2, 17.13 for PISCO3.

fov_diameter_px.title: Field of view (px)
fov_diameter_px.description: Diameter of the lit disc in the frames, in pixels. The depth preview finds it on the raw frames; confirm it there. With the pixel size and the depth of field it gives the volume each frame samples (the part of the disc inside the frame), and so the concentrations in the Data Explorer.

fov_center_x_px.title: Field of view centre x (px)
fov_center_x_px.description: Centre of the disc from the frame's left edge; the depth preview fills it. Empty: the frame's centre.

fov_center_y_px.title: Field of view centre y (px)
fov_center_y_px.description: Centre of the disc from the frame's top edge; the depth preview fills it. Empty: the frame's centre.

depth_of_field_mm.title: Depth of field (mm)
depth_of_field_mm.description: Depth of the imaged volume along the optical axis. 500 mm is the old pipeline's value for PISCO2; nobody has measured either camera's yet.

deconv_model.title: Deconvolution model
deconv_model.description: Model file of the deconvolution step, a name in its models folder or a full path. Trained on PISCO2 frames.

sensor_log.title: Sensor log
sensor_log.description: Pressure/temperature log, matched to frames by time: a file, or a folder of logs. For PISCO3 the folder of Keller logs, of which the files around the cast are read

binary_model.title: Binary ViT
binary_model.description: Model directory or HF id of the living/not-living stage. Veit's public models are snapshotted under /mnt/pisco/models/vit/ (M181_* and ATAIIR2604_NorthSea_*).

taxon_model.title: Taxon ViT
taxon_model.description: Model directory or HF id of the taxon stage, run on the living objects. Its labels must all be in ecotaxa_taxonomy_map.json - M181_multiclass is; ATAIIR2604_NorthSea_multiclass still lacks four.

pca_path.title: PCA basis
pca_path.description: PCA basis for EcoTaxa similarity search; the same file for every project that should be comparable

variants.name: profile_pisco3
variants.description: One PISCO3 profile, from the recorder's .h5 files to EcoTaxa: pick the cast by time (Pick a cast / Fill from DSHIP), then the same chain as 'profile'. Defaults for the PISCO3 camera: 4504 px frames at 17.13 µm/px. Deconvolution and the ViT models were trained on PISCO2 and are tried as they are.
